tax_year.rationale: Tax year is a form header attribute not represented as a standalone canonical element in the MeF schema for Schedule A.

taxpayer_name.rationale: Taxpayer name is a form header field not present in the Schedule A canonical element list.

ssn.rationale: SSN is a form header field not present as a canonical element in this Schedule A schema.

medical_dental_expenses.rationale: MedicalAndDentalExpensesAmt corresponds to Line 1 gross medical and dental expenses.

agi_for_medical.rationale: TaxReturnAGIAmt corresponds to Line 2 AGI used as the base for the medical expense floor.

medical_agi_floor.rationale: CalculatedMedicalAllowanceAmt corresponds to Line 3, the computed AGI floor (AGI × 7.5%).

medical_dental_deduction.rationale: TotalMedicalAndDentalExpnssAmt corresponds to Line 4, the deductible medical amount after subtracting the AGI floor.

state_local_income_or_sales_tax.rationale: StateAndLocalTaxAmt corresponds to Line 5a, the elected state and local income or sales tax amount.

state_local_income_tax_elected.rationale: StateAndLocalSalesTaxInd indicates whether sales tax was elected; when false/absent, income tax is elected, covering the Line 5a checkbox.

state_local_real_estate_taxes.rationale: RealEstateTaxesAmt corresponds to Line 5b, state and local real estate taxes.

state_local_personal_property_taxes.rationale: PersonalPropertyTaxesAmt corresponds to Line 5c, state and local personal property taxes.

state_local_taxes_subtotal.rationale: TotalStateAndLocalTaxAmt corresponds to Line 5d, the sum of Lines 5a–5c before the SALT cap.

salt_deduction.rationale: StateAndLocalTaxLimitationAmt corresponds to Line 5e, the SALT-capped deductible amount.

other_taxes.rationale: OtherTaxesAmt corresponds to Line 6, other taxes not captured in the SALT lines.

total_taxes.rationale: TotalTaxesPaidAmt corresponds to Line 7, the total deductible taxes paid.

home_mortgage_interest_1098.rationale: RptHomeMortgIntAndPointsAmt corresponds to Line 8a, home mortgage interest and points reported on Form 1098.

home_mortgage_interest_no_1098.rationale: Form1098HomeMortgIntNotRptAmt corresponds to Line 8b, home mortgage interest not reported on Form 1098.

home_mortgage_interest_no_1098_recipient.rationale: Recipient name for Line 8b supporting detail is not represented as a canonical element in this Schedule A schema.
Recipient SSN/EIN for Line 8b supporting detail is not represented as a canonical element in this Schedule A schema.

points_not_on_1098.rationale: Form1098PointsNotReportedAmt corresponds to Line 8c, mortgage points not reported on Form 1098.

mortgage_insurance_premiums.rationale: No canonical element for mortgage insurance premiums (Line 8d) exists in this Schedule A candidate list.

investment_interest.rationale: InvestmentInterestAmt corresponds to Line 9, investment interest expense.

total_interest.rationale: TotalInterestPaidAmt corresponds to Line 10, the total interest deduction.

cash_check_charity.rationale: GiftsByCashOrCheckAmt corresponds to Line 11, gifts to charity by cash or check.

noncash_charity.rationale: OtherThanByCashOrCheckAmt corresponds to Line 12, noncash charitable gifts.

carryover_from_prior_year.rationale: CarryoverFromPriorYearAmt corresponds to Line 13, charitable contribution carryover from a prior year.

total_charity.rationale: TotalCharitableContriAmt corresponds to Line 14, total charitable contributions.

casualty_theft_loss.rationale: No canonical element for casualty and theft loss (Line 15) exists in this Schedule A candidate list.

other_itemized_deductions.rationale: OtherMiscellaneousDedAmt corresponds to Line 16, other itemized deductions.

other_itemized_deductions_description.rationale: A text description of other itemized deductions is not represented as a canonical element in this Schedule A schema.

total_itemized_deductions.rationale: TotalItemizedDeductionsAmt corresponds to Line 17, the total itemized deductions carried to Form 1040.

itemizing_though_standard_higher.rationale: ItmzdDedLessThanStdDedInd corresponds to the checkbox indicating the filer is itemizing even though itemized deductions are less than the standard deduction.
